patches.description: Return false from the virtual-input setting read
patches.rationale: The 4.43.1 settings read defaults to the enabled value 2 when the stored setting is missing, so this patch keeps the SendInput fallback selected after every config refresh.

patches.description: Store false in the runtime virtual-input setter
patches.rationale: The 4.43.1 runtime setter stores the incoming control-message byte to the manager flag at 0x1405b2961; zeroing the movzbl keeps runtime control messages on the SendInput path.
